## A. Intake & security
Webhook is protected by a Header Auth secret (X-BookLeaf-Secret); a wrong or missing secret is rejected by n8n with 403 before anything runs. The payload from Bubble is validated, never trusted.

## B. Idempotency (best-effort)
Per-author lock in workflow static data. NOT atomic and NOT guaranteed; Bubble claim-then-arbitrate is the enforced guard. Released after the response, only by the owning request.

## C. Deterministic facts
All money, dates, payout mode and the next-payout date are computed here in code and re-checked against Bubble totals. The AI never calculates.

## D. AI + validation
One call (retry on transient errors). Output is validated: number/date whitelist, required content, mode rules (no payout-date promise when overdue). One regeneration with the violations, otherwise Failed(output_validation). OpenAI errors go to the error output -> Failed(ai).

## E. Response
Bubble Free plan cannot receive an inbound callback, so the result (Success/Failed, timestamp, email, failure stage) is returned as this webhook's HTTP response. Every branch ends here.
